judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer's Major Comment 4 discusses Section 3.6 and virial equilibrium but does not challenge the claim that Solomon et al. 1987 is a hydrodynamic simulation paper rather than an observational CO survey. No reviewer flag addresses the misattribution of methodology to Solomon1987.

The review comments on Section 3.6 discuss virial-equilibrium assumptions and requested sizes/masses, but do not challenge the citation to Solomon 1987 or say the cited source is observational rather than hydrodynamic simulations. There is no specific flag about a citation-methodology mismatch.
The reviewer discusses Section 3.6 in Major Comment 4 regarding virial equilibrium calculations but does not mention the mis-attribution of Solomon et al. 1987 as a hydrodynamic simulation paper.

The reviewer makes no mention of a discrepancy between the ~80 pc figure in the Conclusions and the ~800 pc figures in the Abstract and Section 3.5. No numerical inconsistency of this kind is flagged anywhere in the report.

The reviewer does not mention the conclusions bullet, the 80 pc/800 pc discrepancy, or any inconsistent spatial extent value across Abstract, Section 3.5, and Conclusions. No numeric inconsistency matching this injection is flagged.
The reviewer fails to notice the discrepancy between the 80 pc value in the conclusions and the 800 pc value used in the abstract and Section 3.5.

The reviewer does not mention Equation 1 or the CO luminosity formula at all, and never challenges the (1+z) exponent. The minor comment about Appendix A.4 Equation A.1 concerns a different equation entirely.

The only equation-related remark concerns Appendix A.4 Equation A.1 and a possible exponent/unit formatting issue there, not Eq. (1) in Section 3.3 or the (1+z) redshift factor in the Solomon CO luminosity formula. Thus the specific mathematical injection was not detected.
The reviewer provides feedback on formatting in Equation A.1 in the Appendix but does not flag the incorrect power of the redshift factor in Equation 1.

The reviewer does not flag any contradiction between the claim of a matched synthesized beam enabling pixel-by-pixel comparison and the clearly different beams quoted in the same paragraph, Appendix A.3, or Table A.1. No such methodology-setup inconsistency is mentioned anywhere in the report.

The report does not mention any contradiction about matched synthesized beams, direct pixel-by-pixel comparison without regridding, or inconsistency with Appendix A.3/Table A.1. No methodology-versus-setup inconsistency corresponding to the inserted sentence is flagged.

The reviewer explicitly mentions Table A.1 to correct a LaTeX typo but fails to notice that the beam sizes listed there contradict the claim in Section 2.1 that the beams were matched to allow comparison without regridding.
